'''Yen Bachask''' was a regional [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Yarille]].

==History==
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Yen Bachask was left in ruins following [[Battle of Yarille|fighting]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Afterward, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Djinn Altis/Legends|Djinn Altis]] led a [[Altisian Jedi|group]] of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] to the city, to carry out relief work.
